name: Adam, The First
summary: The Zero's vessel: he channels Zero Matter and opens the way to the Union of the Rubyfront of the Abyss.

face.name: Adam, The First

genesis.name: Genesis
genesis.text: search your deck for a Zero Matter card, reveal it to your opponent and add it to your hand, then shuffle your deck. You can’t play that Matter this turn.

bequest.name: Bequest
bequest.text: Draw a card. (Triggers on every exit from the field: retirement to the Requiem Zone included, which is not a death.)

face.flavor: He was the first to touch the Zero. Ever since, humanity was changed forever.
